text:
maria_cs: Neptune Labs submitted a combined SOC2 + vendor risk questionnaire (attached). They asked for responses by EOD tomorrow. Anyone able to own answers? cc @sophie_security @jon_eng @dylan_se

vendor-bot: Form V-2026-308 received. SLA: 48hr turnaround requested. Link: https://vendor-portal.example.com/forms/V-2026-308

sophie_security: I can take the SOC2 section. Need asset inventory, control mappings for infra & app, and where logs are retained. Also will want the last pen test date.

jon_eng: I can provide infra answers. Quick notes: hosted uses AWS-managed CMKs (AES-256). Dedicated/Private can use customer-managed KMS/HSM. Data residency: hosted default is multi-region; we can enable EU-only storage on enterprise contracts. CloudTrail logs retention: hosted 90d, Dedicated 365d by default. Snippet we can paste into the form:

```
Encryption at rest: AES-256 with AWS-managed CMKs (hosted). Customer-managed KMS/HSM available for Dedicated/Private deployments.
Logging: Application and infrastructure logs forwarded to CloudWatch/CloudTrail; retention configurable per customer (hosted default 90 days, Dedicated default 365 days).
Pen testing: Internal SAST/DAST weekly, dependency scanning continuous, external pentest annually with report redaction available upon request.
```

dylan_se: I'll handle the vendor risk control matrix and questions about third-party dependencies. Current cadence: weekly automated scans, monthly dependency reports, annual external penetration test. Will note our process for vulnerability triage and SLA for critical fixes.

legal_amy: Please route any DPA language edits to legal@redwood.ai. If they require EU SCCs or specific subprocessor lists, we have a standard addendum; I'll review any redlines.

sophie_security: Uploading draft answers to the shared folder now: https://internal.redwood/example/neptune-soc2-answers. Please review and add comments before EOD so I can finalize.

jon_eng: Added the asset inventory and a brief data flow diagram (high level). Also noted that inference logs have PII scrubbing in the pipeline (regex redaction + token hash); can include an example pattern if they ask.

maria_cs: Appreciate the help — I'll coordinate legal review then send to the customer. Follow-ups to track: EU-only storage confirmation (jon_eng), customer KMS/HSM option doc (jon_eng), pentest report redaction procedure (dylan_se).

vendor-bot: Reminder set for 24h before SLA due date.

sophie_security: :thumbsup:
